description: This bar chart, titled “Self-reflection SFT data statistic” from the paper “SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware Reinforcement Learning,” displays the number of samples for six distinct reasoning categories on a logarithmic y-axis labeled “Number of Samples,” which ranges from 10² to 10⁴ with tick marks at intervals of one order of magnitude. The x-axis lists the reasoning categories in descending order of sample count: “Mathematical Reasoning,” “General Reasoning,” “Natural Scene Reasoning,” “Physical Reasoning,” “Logical Puzzle Reasoning,” and “Chemical Reasoning.” Each category is represented by a single, light blue, ungrouped bar whose height corresponds to its sample count, explicitly labeled above each bar. The bars are arranged in descending order from left to right, with “Mathematical Reasoning” having the highest count of 7,025 samples, followed by “General Reasoning” at 1,709, “Natural Scene Reasoning” at 413, “Physical Reasoning” at 232, “Logical Puzzle Reasoning” at 91, and “Chemical Reasoning” at 49. All bars are visually uniform in color and style, with no grouping, stacking, or emphasis applied.
